job: Show that a page is navigating or reloading with a thin bar at the top.
purpose: A 2px accent bar fixed at the top of the page. start() trickles it toward 94%, set(0 to 1) moves it, and done() completes it and fades it out. createPagebar(host) makes one scoped to a positioned element. Use it for navigation and full reloads, never for work inside a panel.
useWhen: A route change or a full reload takes a moment and the page has nothing of its own to show yet.
One region fetches new content and the bar is scoped to that region.

avoidWhen.when: Work inside a panel or a control.
A known amount of progress with a label.
A region whose layout is known.

variants.useWhen: The bar sits at the top of a positioned element instead of the viewport.

parts.role: The moving fill with the accent glow.
